prose.subject: Invoice INV-65511 - Galloway Security
prose.body:
Dear Greywater Robotics Accounts Payable,

Please find attached invoice INV-65511 for security services rendered during the current billing cycle. The total amount due is 3,879.99 USDC.

Line Items:
1. Perimeter Sensor Calibration: 1,250.00 USDC
2. Access Control System Maintenance: 980.50 USDC
3. Monthly Software License Fee: 1,100.00 USDC
4. Emergency Response Standby Fee: 549.49 USDC

Payment is due within 30 days of receipt. Please remit funds to our standard receiving account: 0x1a534b65c96dc7ae68f8808e0000a09dc6fd766e.

If you have any questions regarding these charges, please contact our billing department at billing@galloway-security.example. We appreciate your continued business and prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Galloway Security Billing Team
